title: A person who loves to grow plants
bullets: and explain why he/she loves growing plants

notes.label: Plants
notes.text: herbs (basil, mint, rau răm), cherry tomatoes, chillies, lime tree, orchids

notes.label: How
notes.text: tiered shelves, self-watering pots, compost, YouTube; 15 mins every morning

notes.label: Why
notes.text: mind goes quiet; food safety; village childhood

segments.v: I want to talk about my mother. She loves growing plants. We live in an apartment, so she grows plants on our balcony. She grows herbs, tomatoes, chillies, a small lime tree and some orchids. She waters the plants every morning before she goes to work. She uses special pots that keep water. She also makes fertiliser from vegetable waste. She learned how to grow plants from YouTube. I think she loves growing plants because it helps her relax after work. Her job is very stressful. She also wants to have clean vegetables for our family. She grew up in the countryside so she likes plants. She is very happy when she cooks with her own herbs.
